plugins.description: See every Account Pooler account's limiting quota window and its reset time in one compact sidebar list.
plugins.overview:
Keep the whole Account Pooler visible without opening a settings page.

## One account, one row

Open **Account usage** from the sidebar footer to see a single flat list. Every
row contains the Claude or Codex mark, the provider's subscription tier, one flat
usage bar, the percentage, and a tiny window/reset line. There are no cards,
provider group headings, separators, hover states, or status-dot clutter; the
disclosure itself is transparent and borderless.

The bar shows the window that actually limits the account right now. When a
window is spent, the row reports the spent window that clears last and its
reset, so an account with an empty 5-hour window but a spent weekly quota reads
`Weekly` and not an empty bar. When every window still has room, the row reports
the one closest to its limit. The bar remains neutral below 75%, changes to
warning yellow at 75%, and turns critical red at 90%; a row the pool cannot
route to is red with a red window/reset line regardless of the percentage.

## Live and local

The list refreshes every 30 seconds while open. Account Pooler continues to own
authentication, secret storage, routing, and upstream quota refreshes. Pool
Usage reads only the redacted account status already exposed by Account
Pooler's typed RPC. For a Codex account whose tier is missing there, it can
match the plan label from BB's official provider usage by account email;
credentials and tokens never enter the plugin or frontend.

Disabled, held, and unavailable accounts stay in place with quiet inline
states, preserving the pool's stable order without expanding the interface.

## More San Francisco Plugins

Pool Usage is one of the San Francisco Plugins, a family of BB plugins. The
others:

- **Super Hotkeys**: Superhuman-like keyboard navigation, with shortcut hints,
  slash search, and number keys that set up a new thread.
- **Bookmarks**: save any chat message and jump back to it from the thread's
  right panel.
- **Dia Sidebar**: the sidebar's navigation as a compact, wrapping grid of
  icons.
- **Server Switcher**: if you run several servers on bb connect, one click opens
  the next online one.

See all of them, with install steps, at
[github.com/rebryk/bb-plugins](https://github.com/rebryk/bb-plugins).

plugins.description: Bookmark any chat message and jump back to it from a Bookmarks tab in the thread's right panel.
plugins.overview:
Save the answers worth coming back to, and get back to them in one click.

## Bookmark from the message

Every user and assistant message gets a **Bookmark** button in its action bar.
Click it and the message is saved; the button stays filled on that message, the
way a liked message looks, and clicking it again removes the bookmark with an
Undo. Select part of an assistant answer and choose **Bookmark** from the
selection menu to save just that passage as the bookmark's quote.

## A Bookmarks tab on the right

Open **Bookmarks** from the thread header, the side panel's new-tab actions, or
the quick palette (`Bookmarks: Show saved messages`). The tab lists every
bookmark, newest first, with its thread and when you saved it. Search matches
the saved text and thread titles in any case, and **This thread** narrows the
list to the open thread in timeline order.

Click a bookmark to jump straight to its message: bb opens the thread, scrolls
the timeline to the message, and flashes it, however far back it is. When the
message lives in another thread, the Bookmarks tab opens beside it so you can
keep browsing. Hover a bookmark to copy its full text or remove it.

## Local

Bookmarks live in the plugin's own SQLite database on your bb server. Each one
keeps a copy of the message text, so a bookmark stays readable after its thread
is deleted. Nothing is sent to an agent or an external service.

plugins.description: Compact, wrapping sidebar icons with live dots and counts in the lower-right corner.
plugins.overview:
Keep your navigation close at hand while leaving more room for threads.

## A grid of icons

Dia Sidebar turns the top sidebar navigation into compact square icon buttons
that sit edge to edge. The grid wraps automatically as the sidebar gets
narrower or wider. Buttons match BB's footer controls in size and appearance,
follow the active BB theme, keep the current destination highlighted, and
reveal their names on hover. The grid adds no vertical padding between BB's
header and thread list.

## Search in one click

Search threads appears as a magnifying-glass button alongside the other icons.
Click it to open BB's thread search. If you previously hid Search threads,
enable it in Customize sidebar.

## Familiar controls

Your existing navigation order and hidden items still apply. Open More or
right-click a tile to use BB's menus. Keyboard users can focus a tile and press
Shift+F10 or the Context Menu key. Arrange items in Customize sidebar;
dragging inside the grid does not reorder them. Search, keyboard shortcuts,
and opening a destination in a split continue through BB's own controls.

## Live indicators

When another plugin supplies a sidebar indicator, Dia Sidebar keeps that
component running inside a bounded area in the lower-right corner of the icon
tile. Large indicators shrink proportionally to fit; small ones keep their
natural size. Live changes refit automatically without moving nearby buttons.
BB controls which indicators are available on compact screens.

## Choose your navigation

Select Dia Sidebar under Settings → Appearance → Navigation. Choose BB again
to return to the standard list. No external account or service is required.

plugins.description: Switch servers in one click: Change Server in the sidebar footer opens your next online bb connect server.
plugins.overview:
Hop between the BB servers on your bb connect account without typing an address.

## One button

**Change Server** sits in the sidebar footer. Each click opens the next online
server at its home page in the same tab. Servers follow alphabetical handle
order, offline ones are skipped, and the last one wraps around to the first.
There is no menu and nothing to configure. When no other server is online, a
message says so.

## In the apps

The BB mobile app doesn't let plugins change its server, so a tap opens
**This device**, where **Servers** lists the app's saved servers. BB Desktop
changes servers only from **Window → Server**, so it shows no button.

## Requirements

Open BB through bb connect, at `https://<handle>.getbb.app`. The plugin reads
your server list with that page's existing session and stores nothing. Install
it on every server you switch between, so the button is there after each
switch.

plugins.description: Superhuman-like keyboard navigation for BB: instant shortcut hints, slash search, and number keys that set up a new thread.
plugins.overview:
Superhuman-like keyboard navigation for BB: see where each shortcut goes and
set up a new thread without the mouse. [Superhuman](https://superhuman.com/mail)
is the email client where every action has a key.

## Instant hints

Hold a modifier to show the remaining keys next to visible controls immediately.
The badges are small grey pills that follow your current bindings. On a Mac,
holding Command turns a Command+Shift+M hint into Shift+M; add Shift to see M.

## New thread setup

Set up a new thread before typing its prompt. While the prompt is empty, 1 opens
the project, 2 the model, 3 the machine and 4 the branch; numbers then choose
options in BB's native menus. In the model picker they choose the provider, and
BB restores its last model and reasoning. The first ten options are numbered
1–9 and 0; BB's own keys reach the rest. After each choice, focus returns to
the prompt. Typing hides the numbers; press Escape first to start a prompt with
a digit.

## Search and plugins

Outside text inputs and open menus, slash opens BB's existing Search threads.
The plugin leaves your command-palette binding and Cmd+F alone.

Command+P on a Mac and Ctrl+P elsewhere open the Plugins page. BB's Quick open
file has the same default key, and BB gives a plugin command no key that
another command uses, so clear or change Quick open file's key in Settings →
Keyboard first. The command is also in the command palette.

## Settings

Enable hints, slash search and numbered setup independently in plugin settings.
On phones and tablets, where touch is the main input, they stay off.
